question: Micro credit or micro finance is a novel approach to bank with poor. In this approach bank credit is extended to the poor through _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**self-help groups.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Microfinance or microcredit** refers to the provision of **financial services, including loans, savings, insurance, and training **to people living in poverty.
 
• These services are typically targeted at underserved populations who do not have access to typical banking services. The approach is designed to support **entrepreneurship, empower poor individuals, and stimulate economic growth.**
 
• In this mode of operation, bank credit is extended to the poor through **Self Help Groups (SHGs)**, which are small voluntary associations of poor people created for the purpose of solving their common problems.
 
• SHGs usually consist of **10-20 individuals** from a homogeneous class who come together to pool their resources to cope with emergencies, provide **collateral-free loans** to members, and often serve as a conduit for formal banking services.
 
• This approach has proven successful in reaching large numbers of poor individuals, particularly women, and allowing them to partake in **income-generating activities.**
